answer_1.quote: Text style transfer is the task of converting a sentence from one style to another while preserving style-agnostic semantics.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the joint measure ... We measure style transfer accuracy ... We measure the similarity between sentences ... Fluency ... we measure the average perplexity (PPL) of the generated sentences ...

answer_4.quote: We also conduct human evaluation on GYAFC EM and Amazon datasets. As with automatic evaluation, we evaluate three criteria: fluency, style control, and content preservation.
answer_4.guideline: Human judges rate each generated sentence on fluency, style control, and content preservation.
